archimate:DataObject.name: CSV files
archimate:DataObject.documentation: Flat files used for manual data exchange between the feeder systems and eFin, since eFin's core modules have no automated integration by default (per OneAdvanced's product design — automation would require their separate CIBR product, which HE does not currently use). All CSV processing is manual, which is flagged as a cyber risk given the lack of validation or automated controls around this exchange.

properties.value: No input validation; manual handling increases error and exposure risk
